name: nxvim-edithost-web
description: Web shell for the wasm edit-host: the Web Worker that owns core+Lua+OPFS (worker.mjs), the DOM renderer + input/mouse layer + window.__nxvim hook (index.html, with client-side tree-sitter highlighting via highlight.js), a cross-origin-isolated dev server (serve.mjs), and the Playwright verifiers (verify.mjs = editor/transport/OPFS contract; verify-ui.mjs = renderer/mouse/selection/layout/highlighting). Build the wasm first with ../build.sh.
